weeks.theme: Baseline, file management, paper inspection, and command words
weeks.milestone: Every learner can inspect an instruction, identify the required application, and produce correct file evidence.

sessions.focus: Baseline practical mindset and command-word discipline
sessions.targetSkill: Read, plan, execute, verify routine
sessions.reasoningRequirement: Explain what the question asks for before touching the computer.
sessions.proofTask: Mark a sample practical paper by circling command verbs, output evidence, and file-name requirements.
sessions.lmsExtensionTask: Complete baseline leak gate and submit a one-paragraph method reflection.
sessions.remediationRule: If command verbs are missed, assign instruction-control drills before practical work.
sessions.n6TransferLink: N6 requires the same instruction-control routine across integrated tasks.

sessions.targetSkill: Create, rename, move, copy, save-as, and verify files and folders.
sessions.reasoningRequirement: Distinguish move from copy and file name from file extension.
sessions.proofTask: Build a folder tree from paper instructions and explain where final evidence should be saved.
sessions.lmsExtensionTask: Upload or record proof of final folder structure and file naming checklist.
sessions.remediationRule: If file extension or wrong-folder errors appear, repeat strict file-control drills.
sessions.n6TransferLink: N6 integration breaks quickly when file evidence is weak.

sessions.targetSkill: Work under a 20-minute micro-practical window.
sessions.reasoningRequirement: State the planned order before starting and the verification step before finishing.
sessions.proofTask: Complete a mini file-control PBQ and correct a true/false scenario about save-as and file extensions.
sessions.lmsExtensionTask: System records baseline leaks and recommends first remediation category.
sessions.remediationRule: Critical file-control leaks block the next release until corrected.
sessions.n6TransferLink: Baseline habits become the N6 evidence-control foundation.

weeks.theme: Word foundations: layout, tab stops, page breaks, tables, and justified content
weeks.milestone: Learners can inspect a Word output and justify visible formatting evidence.

sessions.focus: Word page setup and visible output evidence
sessions.targetSkill: Margins, orientation, headers, footers, page numbering, and page breaks.
sessions.reasoningRequirement: Explain why page setup is an output-control decision, not decoration.
sessions.proofTask: Inspect a printed layout and identify where page break, header, footer, and numbering evidence appears.
sessions.lmsExtensionTask: Complete Word layout inspection checklist.
sessions.remediationRule: If evidence cannot be named, assign paper inspection before Word clicking drills.
sessions.n6TransferLink: N6 reports require the same output evidence discipline.

sessions.focus: Tabs, alignment, tables, and justified content
sessions.targetSkill: Use tab stops, table structure, alignment, and justified paragraphs appropriately.
sessions.reasoningRequirement: Tell when a tab stop is justified instead of spaces or a table.
sessions.proofTask: Label a document sample: tab stop, table, alignment, page break, and justified paragraph.
sessions.lmsExtensionTask: Submit true/false correction items on tab stops and page breaks.
sessions.remediationRule: If learners use spaces for alignment, assign tab-stop rebuild practice.
sessions.n6TransferLink: Professional layout control transfers into N6 document production.

sessions.targetSkill: Rebuild a formatted document from inspection evidence.
sessions.reasoningRequirement: Use the paper output to decide commands before execution.
sessions.proofTask: Complete a 30-minute Word PBQ and explain two mark-earning layout decisions.
sessions.lmsExtensionTask: Record Word layout leaks and route remediation.
sessions.remediationRule: Weak layout evidence triggers Word layout and verification drills.
sessions.n6TransferLink: N6 integrated reports reuse these Word decisions under more pressure.

weeks.theme: Word production, mail merge, hyperlinks, bookmarks, and output control
weeks.milestone: Learners can plan multi-step Word production and verify the final output.

sessions.targetSkill: Connect data source, insert fields, preview, finish, and verify output.
sessions.reasoningRequirement: Explain each mail merge stage and what evidence proves it worked.
sessions.proofTask: Write the mail merge sequence on paper before opening Word.
sessions.lmsExtensionTask: Complete mail-merge sequencing quiz and correction items.
sessions.remediationRule: If sequence is wrong, block timed merge tasks until the flow is stable.
sessions.n6TransferLink: N6 integrated tasks depend on controlled source-to-output logic.

sessions.targetSkill: Insert and verify navigation points inside and across documents.
sessions.reasoningRequirement: Choose link/bookmark only when navigation evidence is required.
sessions.proofTask: Inspect a document and identify where a hyperlink or bookmark is justified.
sessions.lmsExtensionTask: Submit inspection checklist with navigation evidence.
sessions.remediationRule: If learners insert links without purpose, assign evidence-based selection drills.
sessions.n6TransferLink: N6 OneNote and cloud work require the same navigation reasoning.

sessions.targetSkill: Produce, check, and explain final Word output.
sessions.reasoningRequirement: Verify the final file name, pages, field output, and print preview.
sessions.proofTask: Complete a mixed Word production PBQ with final evidence checklist.
sessions.lmsExtensionTask: System records mail merge, layout, and print-output leaks.
sessions.remediationRule: Output-control failures route to print preview and final evidence drills.
sessions.n6TransferLink: Final-output discipline prevents avoidable N6 marks loss.

weeks.theme: Excel foundations: formulas on paper, references, arguments, and fault tracing
weeks.milestone: Learners can write and explain a formula before entering it in Excel.

sessions.targetSkill: Identify function name, arguments, operators, cell references, and expected result.
sessions.reasoningRequirement: Explain what each part of a formula contributes.
sessions.proofTask: Write five formulas on paper and annotate function, arguments, and expected output.
sessions.lmsExtensionTask: Complete paper formula proof task.
sessions.remediationRule: If arguments are missing, assign formula anatomy recall before Excel execution.
sessions.n6TransferLink: N6 formulas become harder when N5 formula anatomy is weak.

sessions.targetSkill: Choose the correct reference type before copying formulas.
sessions.reasoningRequirement: Explain what must stay fixed and what must change.
sessions.proofTask: Predict copied formula changes on paper before testing in Excel.
sessions.lmsExtensionTask: Submit reference tracing drill and correction notes.
sessions.remediationRule: Absolute-reference leaks require copy-down drills before timed work.
sessions.n6TransferLink: N6 data tasks amplify reference errors across larger models.

sessions.targetSkill: Find formula errors by reading source cells, arguments, and output.
sessions.reasoningRequirement: State whether the error is syntax, reference, logic, or formatting.
sessions.proofTask: Correct true/false formula scenarios and complete an Excel PBQ.
sessions.lmsExtensionTask: System records formula logic and verification leaks.
sessions.remediationRule: Formula errors route to paper-before-computer proof until stable.
sessions.n6TransferLink: Fault tracing is essential for N6 unfamiliar data contexts.

weeks.theme: Excel functions, sorting/filtering, charts, print setup, and speed discipline
weeks.milestone: Learners can select the correct Excel method, not just the nearest command.

sessions.targetSkill: Use SUM, AVERAGE, MIN, MAX, COUNTIF, IF, ROUND, and lookup-style reasoning where applicable.
sessions.reasoningRequirement: Choose a function by question wording and data shape.
sessions.proofTask: Match function names to scenarios and type formula examples by hand.
sessions.lmsExtensionTask: Complete function selection and true/false correction set.
sessions.remediationRule: Menu-hunting without logic routes to function-selection drills.
sessions.n6TransferLink: N6 requires function selection under unfamiliar conditions.

sessions.focus: Sort, filter, chart, and presentation-media selection
sessions.targetSkill: Choose the correct data presentation and output setup.
sessions.reasoningRequirement: Explain why a chart type, sort/filter, or print setting is justified.
sessions.proofTask: Inspect paper instructions and identify correct chart and output choices.
sessions.lmsExtensionTask: Submit paper inspection checklist for chart/output decisions.
sessions.remediationRule: Wrong media choice routes to scenario-to-output drills.
sessions.n6TransferLink: N6 integrated tasks require correct media selection across applications.

sessions.targetSkill: Complete formulas, sort/filter, chart, and print settings under time pressure.
sessions.reasoningRequirement: Plan sequence and verification before starting.
sessions.proofTask: Complete a timed Excel PBQ and write a post-task error audit.
sessions.lmsExtensionTask: System records Excel functions, references, sort/filter, print, and time leaks.
sessions.remediationRule: Critical Excel leaks trigger targeted drills before mixed tasks.
sessions.n6TransferLink: This becomes the N6 spreadsheet survival baseline.

weeks.theme: OneNote, file evidence, cross-application links, and practical evidence control
weeks.milestone: Learners can keep evidence organized across applications.

sessions.targetSkill: Capture notes, organize sections/pages, attach or link evidence, and retrieve it.
sessions.reasoningRequirement: Explain why evidence must be retrievable, not just created.
sessions.proofTask: Design a notebook structure on paper for a practical exam evidence trail.
sessions.lmsExtensionTask: Complete notebook workflow reflection and evidence checklist.
sessions.remediationRule: Weak notebook structure routes to evidence organization drills.
sessions.n6TransferLink: N6 notebook workflow expects stable evidence control.

sessions.targetSkill: Move evidence between Word, Excel, OneNote, folders, and screenshots without losing context.
sessions.reasoningRequirement: Explain why each artifact belongs in the evidence chain.
sessions.proofTask: Map an integrated task from source file to final evidence upload.
sessions.lmsExtensionTask: Submit cross-application evidence map.
sessions.remediationRule: Evidence gaps route to file-control and verification discipline drills.
sessions.n6TransferLink: N6 is mainly harder because integration pressure increases.

sessions.targetSkill: Complete a practical task and prove it with correct file, screenshot, and reflection evidence.
sessions.reasoningRequirement: Identify final evidence before starting the practical work.
sessions.proofTask: Timed integrated PBQ with final evidence upload checklist.
sessions.lmsExtensionTask: System records notebook workflow, integration control, and screenshot evidence leaks.
sessions.remediationRule: Missing evidence blocks readiness until corrected.
sessions.n6TransferLink: N6 transfer depends on evidence traceability.

weeks.theme: Mixed PBQs, true/false correction scenarios, and unseen task interpretation
weeks.milestone: Learners can transfer known skills into unfamiliar paper wording.

sessions.targetSkill: Correct false statements using precise exam language.
sessions.reasoningRequirement: Explain the correction, not only the true/false label.
sessions.proofTask: Correct statements about formulas, formatting, page breaks, charts, file extensions, and print preview.
sessions.lmsExtensionTask: Complete correction-based theory set.
sessions.remediationRule: Thin corrections route to memory recall and theory explanation drills.
sessions.n6TransferLink: N6 theory rewards precise correction and explanation.

sessions.targetSkill: Decode a new scenario into known application skills.
sessions.reasoningRequirement: State app, command family, output, evidence, and trap risk.
sessions.proofTask: Plan an unseen PBQ without executing it, then compare plan to memo logic.
sessions.lmsExtensionTask: Submit unseen-paper planning checklist.
sessions.remediationRule: Wrong app/command selection routes to paper inspection drills.
sessions.n6TransferLink: Unseen interpretation is the N6 bridge skill.

sessions.targetSkill: Complete Word, Excel, OneNote, and file-control requirements in one task.
sessions.reasoningRequirement: Use a planned sequence and verify all outputs.
sessions.proofTask: Complete mixed PBQ and mark own result against rubric before lecturer review.
sessions.lmsExtensionTask: System updates dominant leak profile and next intervention.
sessions.remediationRule: Two repeated leaks become the next week's intervention focus.
sessions.n6TransferLink: Mixed-task performance predicts N6 readiness better than isolated recall.

weeks.milestone: Learners know whether they can qualify and what must improve before the internal exam.

sessions.targetSkill: Read mark allocation and plan time before solving.
sessions.reasoningRequirement: Explain which tasks earn marks fastest and which need careful setup.
sessions.proofTask: Annotate a paper with marks, order, risk, and verification points.
sessions.lmsExtensionTask: Complete readiness planning checklist.
sessions.remediationRule: Weak planning routes to time-discipline coaching.
sessions.n6TransferLink: N6 papers punish weak planning more severely.

sessions.targetSkill: Complete a controlled mini-paper with all evidence requirements.
sessions.reasoningRequirement: Use the method: read, plan, execute, verify, submit.
sessions.proofTask: Timed Assignment/Test 1 simulation with final self-mark.
sessions.lmsExtensionTask: System calculates risk against 40 percent threshold and top remediation categories.
sessions.remediationRule: Students below threshold get a targeted three-session intervention plan.
sessions.n6TransferLink: Threshold risk now predicts future N6 support needs.

sessions.targetSkill: Turn mistakes into a targeted practice pathway.
sessions.reasoningRequirement: Classify every error as recall, inspection, method, timing, or verification.
sessions.proofTask: Complete correction log and commit to next LMS extension task.
sessions.lmsExtensionTask: LMS assigns remediation and records metacognitive accuracy reflection.
sessions.remediationRule: Learner must complete remediation before internal exam simulation.
sessions.n6TransferLink: Correction habits become N6 self-regulation.

weeks.theme: Optional internal exam simulation and weak-group intervention
weeks.milestone: At-risk students receive focused support without slowing strong students.

sessions.targetSkill: Target the two most repeated leak categories.
sessions.reasoningRequirement: Explain the error pattern and the corrected method.
sessions.proofTask: Complete targeted intervention PBQ.
sessions.lmsExtensionTask: System assigns individualized remediation.
sessions.remediationRule: Repeated critical leaks require lecturer release before next exam simulation.
sessions.n6TransferLink: Weak N5 patterns become high-risk N6 blockers.

sessions.targetSkill: Complete a harder mixed PBQ with unfamiliar data.
sessions.reasoningRequirement: Transfer familiar method to unfamiliar surface details.
sessions.proofTask: Complete advanced PBQ and explain transfer decisions.
sessions.lmsExtensionTask: System records enrichment evidence.
sessions.remediationRule: Strong students still correct any verification leaks.
sessions.n6TransferLink: Acceleration prepares students for N6 complexity.

sessions.targetSkill: Sustain method, speed, and evidence control across a longer task.
sessions.reasoningRequirement: Plan and verify without lecturer prompting.
sessions.proofTask: Timed internal exam simulation.
sessions.lmsExtensionTask: System updates readiness and predicted qualification risk.
sessions.remediationRule: Simulation failures generate final intervention pack.
sessions.n6TransferLink: Internal exam proof becomes N6 readiness evidence.

weeks.theme: Optional internal exam proof, metacognitive accuracy, and N6 bridge
weeks.milestone: Learners can explain how N5 skills transfer into N6.

sessions.targetSkill: Predict performance and compare it to actual evidence.
sessions.reasoningRequirement: Explain why confidence was accurate or inaccurate.
sessions.proofTask: Complete prediction, attempt, and reflection loop.
sessions.lmsExtensionTask: LMS records confidence versus performance.
sessions.remediationRule: Overconfidence with low marks routes to verification discipline.
sessions.n6TransferLink: N6 success needs accurate self-monitoring.

sessions.targetSkill: Apply N5 Word, Excel, OneNote, and file evidence habits to an N6-style integrated prompt.
sessions.reasoningRequirement: Identify what is the same skill under a harder surface.
sessions.proofTask: Complete a short N6-style transfer PBQ.
sessions.lmsExtensionTask: System records transfer strengths and risks.
sessions.remediationRule: Transfer failures map back to N5 skill remediation.
sessions.n6TransferLink: This is the direct N5-to-N6 bridge.

sessions.targetSkill: Prove readiness with method, evidence, correction, and reflection.
sessions.reasoningRequirement: Defend final approach in learner-friendly language.
sessions.proofTask: Submit final readiness pack: plan, attempt, evidence, correction log, and reflection.
sessions.lmsExtensionTask: LMS locks readiness summary for lecturer review.
sessions.remediationRule: Any unresolved critical leak becomes post-internal support.
sessions.n6TransferLink: Readiness summary follows the learner into N6 support planning.
